scope: Official SQLite documentation and version-pinned SQLite source; examples are independently authored

claims.claim: Expression indexes are considered when query expressions match the CREATE INDEX expression, without general algebraic equivalence
Expression index functions must be deterministic; application-defined functions need SQLITE_DETERMINISTIC
Stale expression indexes can arise when deterministic calculations vary across platforms, OSes or library versions
SQLite 3.53.0 attempts to repair stale expression index entries during some UPDATE or DELETE operations
PRAGMA integrity_check can still report imprecise floating-point values in stale expression indexes
REINDEX EXPRESSIONS rebuilds expression indexes only
sqlite3VdbeFindIndexKey searches for matching primary-key fields and may widen its search
